{"sql": "-- Simple final query - just order by delivered_order_count DESC, LIMIT 3
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        c.customer_city,
        c.customer_state
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        customer_city,
        customer_state,
        COUNT(*) as delivered_order_count
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id, customer_city, customer_state
),
top3_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM customer_order_counts
    ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    coc.customer_unique_id,
    coc.delivered_order_count,
    ROUND(AVG(op.payment_value), 2) as avg_payment_value,
    coc.customer_city,
    coc.customer_state
FROM customer_order_counts coc
JOIN top3_customers t3 ON coc.customer_unique_id = t3.customer_unique_id
JOIN delivered_orders d ON coc.customer_unique_id = d.customer_unique_id
JOIN olist_order_payments op ON d.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY coc.customer_unique_id, coc.delivered_order_count, coc.customer_city, coc.customer_state
ORDER BY coc.delivered_order_count DESC", "preview_rows": 10}
